verdict.rationale: dlt supports pointing pipelines at a local DuckDB destination for quick testing and lets you swap destinations without changing pipeline code, which enables informal sandbox-style testing before touching a production warehouse. However, there is no explicit documented 'sandbox mode', staging/dataset isolation feature, or guidance on safely testing against production schemas without risk. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/staging environment docs, explicit dev-vs-prod dataset isolation guarantees, and any hands-on corroboration that this prevents production data contact.
